subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should OpenClaw accept `disableBoundaryAwareCache` as a public model compatibility option with an automatic DeepSeek default?
rationale: The runtime repair is correct and strongly supported by live proof, but adding an operator-visible configuration field and changing existing provider defaults is a lasting product and upgrade contract that code review cannot authorize alone.

options.title: Approve current design
options.body: Land the public field, DeepSeek default, trailing instruction carrier, and explicit-false compatibility escape hatch.

options.title: Keep policy internal
options.body: Retain the same DeepSeek-specific runtime behavior but remove the operator-visible compatibility field.

options.title: Decline provider special-casing
options.body: Pause or close the change if OpenClaw should not own a DeepSeek-specific prompt-cache policy.

recommendation.title: Approve current design
recommendation.body: Land the public field, DeepSeek default, trailing instruction carrier, and explicit-false compatibility escape hatch.
